# Workout Cassette Format Specification

**Version:** 1.2
**Purpose:** A structured workout session format ("cassette") generated by a Claude skill and consumed by a dumb playback TUI. All intelligence lives at generation time. The player just walks the arrays and speaks the lines.

---

## Design Principles

1. **The skill is the recording studio, the TUI is the tape player.** The player makes zero decisions — no inference, no branching logic, no random selection. Everything it needs is on the tape.
2. **Voice lines are pre-rendered.** Every coaching message is written for *this specific session* by the skill at generation time. The player never picks from a pool.
3. **Sets are arrays, not counts.** `4×10` is shorthand for humans. The format stores four set objects. When one set diverges (failure, drop set), the structure already supports it.
4. **Phases are first-class.** Warmup, main, and cooldown are explicit groupings that affect TUI rendering.
5. **Context exercises live outside the phase loop.** Exercises done elsewhere (park walk pullups, daily mobility) are announced but never enter the set-by-set flow.
6. **No cassette storage.** The player outputs a human-readable log during and after the session. That log is what the user pastes into their health project history. The cassette is ephemeral — played and discarded.
7. **Exercise recipes provide consistency.** Common exercises have standard rest times and form cues. The skill references these defaults so the user gets a consistent experience across sessions.
8. **Format-agnostic to modality.** This format works for strength training, posture work, yoga flows, mobility sessions, or any workout expressible as phases → groups → exercises → sets. A yoga session is just a different cassette.

---

## Schema

### Top-Level Object

```json
{
  "version": "1.2",
  "meta": { ... },
  "phases": [ ... ],
  "context_exercises": [ ... ],
  "voice": { ... }
}
```

| Field                | Type   | Required | Description |
|----------------------|--------|----------|-------------|
| `version`            | string | yes      | Schema version. Currently `"1.2"`. Players must also accept `"1.1"`. |
| `meta`               | object | yes      | Session metadata. |
| `phases`             | array  | yes      | Ordered list of workout phases. |
| `context_exercises`  | array  | no       | Exercises performed outside the main session. |
| `voice`              | object | yes      | Session-level voice lines. |

---

### `meta`

```json
{
  "date": "2026-03-21",
  "title": "Full Body B — Week 6",
  "program": "Phase 1 - Foundation",
  "session_number": 18,
  "rest_default": 120
}
```

| Field            | Type    | Required | Description |
|------------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `date`           | string  | yes      | ISO 8601 date for this session. |
| `title`          | string  | yes      | Human-readable session title. |
| `program`        | string  | no       | Name of the broader training program/phase. |
| `session_number` | integer | no       | Sequential session count (for voice context). |
| `rest_default`   | integer | yes      | Default rest in seconds. Used when a group omits `rest`. |

---

### `phases`

Array of phase objects. Rendered in order. Typical sequence: warmup → main → cooldown.

```json
{
  "type": "main",
  "voice_intro": "Main work. Five exercises, two supersets. Let's get after it.",
  "groups": [ ... ]
}
```

| Field         | Type   | Required | Description |
|---------------|--------|----------|-------------|
| `type`        | string | yes      | One of: `"warmup"`, `"main"`, `"cooldown"`. |
| `voice_intro` | string | no       | Spoken when the phase begins. |
| `groups`      | array  | yes      | Ordered list of exercise groups. Can be empty (e.g. cooldown with just a voice line). |

---

### `groups` (within a phase)

A group is the atomic scheduling unit. It's either a single exercise, a superset, or a circuit. The player treats all three the same way — it walks the `exercises` array, cycles through them for the prescribed number of rounds, and rests after each complete round.

```json
{
  "type": "straight",
  "rounds": 4,
  "rest": 120,
  "exercises": [ ... ],
  "voice_intro": "Bench press, 55s. You dropped set 3 last time. Today we get all four.",
  "voice_round_complete": [
    "Round one, smooth.",
    "Two. Felt easy.",
    "Three. That's the one that got you. Not today.",
    "All four. 55 is yours now."
  ],
  "voice_group_complete": "Bench done. First clean sweep at this weight."
}
```

| Field                  | Type    | Required | Description |
|------------------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `type`                 | string  | yes      | `"straight"` (one exercise), `"superset"` (2 exercises, alternating), or `"circuit"` (3+ exercises, rotating). |
| `rounds`               | integer | yes      | Number of complete rounds. For straight sets this equals set count. For supersets this is how many times through the pair. |
| `rest`                 | integer | no       | Rest in seconds after each complete round. Falls back to `meta.rest_default`. |
| `exercises`            | array   | yes      | 1 exercise for straight, 2 for superset, 3+ for circuit. |
| `voice_intro`          | string  | no       | Spoken when this group begins. |
| `voice_round_complete` | array   | no       | One string per round, spoken after each completed round. Length must match `rounds`. |
| `voice_group_complete` | string  | no       | Spoken after the final round. |
| `voice_during_set`     | array   | no       | Timed hold cues. One sub-array per round. See Timed Hold Voice Cues. |

**Playback for each group type:**

- **straight:** Exercise A, rest. Exercise A, rest. ... (N rounds)
- **superset:** Exercise A → Exercise B, rest. Exercise A → Exercise B, rest. ... (N rounds)
- **circuit:** Exercise A → Exercise B → Exercise C, rest. ... (N rounds)

Rest is always *after* a full round, never between exercises within a round.

---

### `exercises` (within a group)

```json
{
  "name": "DB Bench Press",
  "load": "55 lbs",
  "timed": false,
  "sets": [
    { "reps": 10 },
    { "reps": 10 },
    { "reps": 10 },
    { "reps": 10 }
  ]
}
```

| Field      | Type    | Required | Description |
|------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `name`     | string  | yes      | Exercise name as displayed and spoken. |
| `load`     | string  | yes      | Weight or resistance. `"BW"`, `"light band"`, `"55 lbs"`, `"10 lb vest"`, etc. |
| `timed`    | boolean | yes      | If `true`, `reps` means seconds (timed hold). If `false`, rep count. |
| `sets`     | array   | yes      | One set object per round. `sets[0]` is used in round 1, `sets[1]` in round 2, etc. Length must match parent group's `rounds`. |
| `tempo`    | string  | no       | **v1.2.** Execution tempo, e.g. `"3s eccentric"`. Player displays it next to the rep target every set. Spoken reminders are the generator's job (put them in `voice_intro`), not the player's. |
| `per_side` | boolean | no       | **v1.2.** Unilateral exercise. Player displays the rep target as `10/side`. Log format unchanged — `4×10` on a per-side exercise means 10 per side, as it always implicitly did. |

Example with v1.2 fields:

```json
{
  "name": "DB RDL",
  "load": "60 lbs",
  "timed": false,
  "tempo": "3s eccentric",
  "sets": [{ "reps": 13 }, { "reps": 13 }, { "reps": 13 }, { "reps": 13 }]
}
```
```json
{
  "name": "Bulgarian Split Squat",
  "load": "35 lbs",
  "timed": false,
  "per_side": true,
  "sets": [{ "reps": 12 }, { "reps": 12 }, { "reps": 12 }, { "reps": 12 }]
}
```

**Note:** In a superset/circuit, each exercise's `sets` array must have length equal to the parent group's `rounds`. The player pulls `sets[round_index]` for each exercise in each round.

---

### `sets` (within an exercise)

#### Input (generated by skill)

```json
{ "reps": 10 }
```

| Field  | Type    | Required | Description |
|--------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `reps` | integer | yes      | Target reps, or target seconds if parent exercise has `timed: true`. |

#### Player-Added Fields (during playback)

The player adds these fields in memory during playback for log rendering. Not persisted.

| Field         | Type    | Description |
|---------------|---------|-------------|
| `actual_reps` | integer | Reps actually completed. |
| `failure`     | boolean | `true` if the set ended in failure. |

---

### Timed Hold Voice Cues

For timed exercises, the skill generates voice cues that fire at specific timestamps during the hold. These live on the **group** as `voice_during_set`.

```json
{
  "voice_during_set": [
    [
      { "at_seconds": 10, "line": "Good position. Squeeze the glutes." },
      { "at_seconds": 20, "line": "Breathe. Deep into the stomach." },
      { "at_seconds": 30, "line": "Fifteen seconds. Don't let the hips drop." },
      { "at_seconds": 40, "line": "Five seconds. Hold it." }
    ]
  ]
}
```

Structure: One sub-array per round. Each sub-array contains cue objects.

| Field        | Type    | Required | Description |
|--------------|---------|----------|-------------|
| `at_seconds` | integer | yes      | Seconds from hold start to trigger this line. |
| `line`       | string  | yes      | What to say. |

**In groups with mixed timed/non-timed exercises** (e.g. a circuit with dead hangs and band pull-aparts): The cues only fire during timed exercises. The player knows which exercise is timed and triggers accordingly. The cue arrays are still indexed by round.

---

### `context_exercises`

Exercises performed outside the gym session. Announced but never enter the set-by-set loop.

```json
{
  "name": "Pull-Ups (Weighted)",
  "note": "5 sets to max on your park walk. 10 lb vest. Spread across the walk.",
  "voice": "Pull-ups are separate — hit them on your walk. Five sets, vest on."
}
```

| Field   | Type   | Required | Description |
|---------|--------|----------|-------------|
| `name`  | string | yes      | Exercise name. |
| `note`  | string | yes      | Displayed as text. Instructions for the user. |
| `voice` | string | no       | Spoken once when context exercises are announced. |

---

### `voice` (session-level)

```json
{
  "session_intro": "Full Body B, week 6. Five exercises plus your walk pull-ups. Let's get it.",
  "session_complete": "That's a wrap. Six weeks, no misses. Go eat."
}
```

| Field              | Type   | Required | Description |
|--------------------|--------|----------|-------------|
| `session_intro`    | string | no       | Spoken at the start of the workout. |
| `session_complete` | string | no       | Spoken when all phases are done. |

---

## Playback Sequence

What the TUI does. No decisions, just ordered execution.

```
1. Read cassette JSON
2. Speak voice.session_intro
3. Announce context_exercises (display note, speak voice for each)
4. For each phase:
   a. Speak phase.voice_intro
   b. For each group:
      i.   Speak group.voice_intro
      ii.  For each round (0 to group.rounds - 1):
           - For each exercise in group.exercises:
             · Read exercise.sets[round_index]
             · If timed: countdown 3-2-1 → hold timer
               - Fire voice_during_set[round_index] cues at their at_seconds
               - On completion: done tone
             · If reps: display target, wait for Enter
           - Speak group.voice_round_complete[round_index]
           - Play set-complete tone
           - Rest timer (group.rest or meta.rest_default)
             Skip rest after last round of last group in last phase
      iii. Speak group.voice_group_complete
      iv.  Play group-complete tone
5. Speak voice.session_complete
6. Display final log
```

---

## Log Output

The player renders a human-readable log during and after the workout. This is the only persistent output — the user pastes it into their health project for the skill to use next time.

### Format

```
Pull-Ups (Weighted)   4×11  | 10 lb vest   | Building
DB Bench Press        4×10  | 55 lbs       | Building
One-Arm DB Rows       4×10  | 55 lbs       | Building
Seated OHP            4×10  | 45 lbs       | Building
DB Curls              3×10  | 35 lbs       | Building
DB RDLs               4×13  | 55 lbs       | Building
Goblet Squats         4×13  | 65 lbs       | Building
RKC Planks            3×45s | BW           | Building
```

### Rendering Rules

| Scenario | Rendered |
|----------|----------|
| All sets hit target | `DB Bench Press        4×10  \| 55 lbs  \| Building` |
| Set 3 failed at 5 | `DB Bench Press        4[3]×10 - failed at 5 on set 3 \| 55 lbs  \| Building` |
| Timed hold, all completed | `RKC Planks            3×45s \| BW      \| Building` |
| Superset exercises | Rendered as individual lines. Grouping is session structure, not log structure. |
| Context exercises | Rendered in the log if the user reports completion. Not tracked by the TUI. |

The phase label column (`Building`, etc.) comes from `meta.program`. The skill decides what to put there based on the health project's prescription.

---

## Exercise Recipe Reference

Standard defaults for common exercises. The skill uses these as baseline values when generating cassettes. The health project can override any value — these exist so the format stays consistent when the project doesn't specify.

### Warmup Exercises

General-purpose warmup movements. A good warmup prepares the joints and movement patterns used in the main work. Typical warmup: 1-2 rounds as a circuit, 30s rest between rounds.

| Exercise | Rest (s) | Form Cues |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| Band Pull-Aparts | 30 | Squeeze scapulae together, arms straight, controlled tempo. |
| Band Dislocates | 30 | Wide grip, slow arc overhead and behind. Only go as far as mobility allows. |
| Light Goblet Squat | 30 | 50% of working weight or less. Focus on depth and hip opening, elbows push knees out. |
| Bodyweight Squat | 30 | Full depth, controlled. Ease into the range of motion. |
| Dead Hang | 45 | Relaxed shoulders, decompress the spine. Breathe. |
| Cat-Cow | 30 | Slow, articulate each vertebra. Match movement to breath. |
| World's Greatest Stretch | 30 | Lunge, rotate, reach. Hits hips, thoracic spine, and hamstrings. |
| Hip 90/90 | 30 | Sit tall, rotate between internal and external rotation. Don't force the range. |
| Arm Circles | 15 | Small to large, forward and back. Gets synovial fluid moving. |
| Glute Bridges | 30 | Squeeze at top, hold 1-2s. Activates posterior chain before heavy work. |

### Compound Movements — Barbell / Dumbbell

| Exercise | Rest (s) | Form Cues |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| Barbell Squat | 150 | Brace before descent, break at hips and knees simultaneously, depth to parallel or below. |
| Goblet Squat | 105 | Elbows between knees at bottom, chest up, full depth. |
| DB Bench Press | 105 | Scapulae retracted, slight arch, feet flat. Control the eccentric. |
| Barbell Bench Press | 150 | Same cues as DB. Unrack with locked arms, touch chest, press to lockout. |
| Seated DB OHP | 105 | Lockout overhead, head through at top. Don't lean back excessively. |
| Barbell OHP | 105 | Brace core, lockout overhead, head through. |
| One-Arm DB Row | 75 | Pull to hip, full stretch at bottom, squeeze at top. Don't rotate the torso. |
| Barbell Row | 105 | Hip hinge, pull to lower chest, squeeze scapulae. |
| DB RDL | 105 | Slow eccentric, hinge at hips not knees, flat back, feel the hamstring stretch. |
| Barbell Deadlift | 150 | Brace before pull, push the floor away, lockout with glutes. |
| Hip Thrust | 105 | Full lockout squeeze at top, chin tucked, don't hyperextend the lower back. |
| Bulgarian Split Squat | 105 | Per-leg. Front shin vertical, control the descent, drive through the front heel. |

### Isolation Movements

| Exercise | Rest (s) | Form Cues |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| DB Curls | 60 | Strict form, no swinging, controlled eccentric. Elbows stay at sides. |
| Hammer Curls | 60 | Neutral grip, same strict cues. |
| Tricep Pushdown | 60 | Elbows pinned to sides, full extension, squeeze at bottom. |
| Overhead Tricep Extension | 75 | Elbows pointing forward, lower behind head, full stretch at bottom. |
| Lateral Raises | 45 | Light load, no momentum, slight forward lean, lead with elbows. |
| Face Pulls | 45 | External rotation at peak, pull to forehead level, squeeze rear delts. |
| Leg Curls | 75 | Controlled eccentric, squeeze at peak contraction. |
| Leg Extensions | 75 | Full lockout, controlled tempo. |
| Calf Raises | 45 | Full ROM, pause at bottom stretch, squeeze at top. |

### Timed / Isometric

| Exercise | Rest (s) | Cue Spacing (s) | Form Cues |
|----------|----------|-----------------|-----------|
| RKC Plank | 90 | 10 | Max tension. Squeeze glutes, engage lats, pull elbows toward toes. |
| Standard Plank | 75 | 15 | Neutral spine, hips level, breathe normally. |
| Dead Hang | 60 | 10 | Relaxed shoulders, deep breaths. Grip work + decompression. |
| Wall Sit | 75 | 10 | 90° knee angle, back flat on wall, don't rest hands on thighs. |
| L-Sit | 75 | 8 | Demanding. Depress shoulders, lock arms. Shorter hold durations typical. |
| Farmer's Carry | 75 | 10 | Tall posture, tight grip, steady breathing, don't let the weight pull you sideways. |
| Copenhagen Plank | 75 | 10 | Adductor focus. Top leg on bench, bottom leg free. Keep hips level. |

### Bodyweight / Calisthenics

| Exercise | Rest (s) | Form Cues |
|----------|----------|-----------|
| Pull-Ups | 105 | Full dead hang at bottom, chin over bar at top. Control the negative. |
| Chin-Ups | 105 | Supinated grip, full ROM. Slightly more bicep emphasis than pull-ups. |
| Dips | 105 | Controlled descent to at least 90° elbow bend, full lockout at top. |
| Push-Ups | 45 | Chest to floor, full lockout, elbows 45° from body. |
| Inverted Rows | 60 | Pull chest to bar, fully extend at bottom. Adjustable difficulty by foot position. |
| Pike Push-Ups | 60 | Hips high, head between arms, vertical pressing pattern. OHP alternative. |

### Common Superset Pairings

Push/pull or agonist/antagonist pairings. The skill should recognize these and suggest superset grouping when the health project prescribes both exercises.

| Pairing | Rest After Round (s) |
|---------|---------------------|
| DB Bench + DB Rows | 105 |
| OHP + Pull-Ups | 105 |
| Barbell Bench + Barbell Row | 135 |
| Curls + Tricep Pushdown | 45 |
| Leg Extensions + Leg Curls | 75 |
| Lateral Raises + Face Pulls | 30 |

## Changelog

### v1.2 (July 2026)
- Added optional `tempo` (string) on exercise objects — player renders next to rep target.
- Added optional `per_side` (boolean) on exercise objects — player renders rep target as `N/side`.
- Both fields are optional and additive. A v1.1 cassette is a valid v1.2 cassette. **Player
  changes required:** accept `"version": "1.2"`, render the two new fields when present. A
  player that ignores unknown fields already plays v1.2 tapes correctly minus the two displays.

### v1.1
- Baseline spec.

## Full Example

```json
{
  "version": "1.2",
  "meta": {
    "date": "2026-03-21",
    "title": "Full Body B — Week 6",
    "program": "Building",
    "session_number": 18,
    "rest_default": 120
  },
  "phases": [
    {
      "type": "warmup",
      "voice_intro": "Quick warmup. Two rounds.",
      "groups": [
        {
          "type": "circuit",
          "rounds": 2,
          "rest": 30,
          "exercises": [
            {
              "name": "Band Pull-Aparts",
              "load": "light band",
              "timed": false,
              "sets": [{ "reps": 15 }, { "reps": 15 }]
            },
            {
              "name": "Bodyweight Squat",
              "load": "BW",
              "timed": false,
              "sets": [{ "reps": 10 }, { "reps": 10 }]
            },
            {
              "name": "Dead Hang",
              "load": "BW",
              "timed": true,
              "sets": [{ "reps": 20 }, { "reps": 20 }]
            }
          ],
          "voice_intro": "Band pull-aparts, bodyweight squats, dead hang. Keep moving.",
          "voice_during_set": [
            [
              { "at_seconds": 10, "line": "Relax into the hang. Let the shoulders stretch." }
            ],
            [
              { "at_seconds": 10, "line": "Breathe and decompress." }
            ]
          ],
          "voice_round_complete": [
            "One round. Loosening up.",
            "Warmed up. Let's work."
          ],
          "voice_group_complete": null
        }
      ]

    {
      "type": "main",

      "note": "5 sets to max on your park walk. 10 lb vest. Spread across the walk.",
      "voice": "Pull-ups are separate — hit them on your walk. Five sets, vest on."
    }
```
